blocks.text: SCHEDULE: UAAP Season 89 basketball tournament – second round MANILA, Philippines–La Salle avenged its first-round loss to Adamson with an 84-69 rout to stay in the hunt for third place in the UAAP Season 89 men’s basketball tournament on Sunday at Smart Araneta Coliseum. The defending champion built a 22-point halftime lead behind Luis Pablo, who scored 12 of his 14 points in the first half, as the Green Archers took control early. Pablo also grabbed seven rebounds, while Jacob Cortez contributed 15 points, four rebounds and four steals in just his second game since returning from injury. La Salle improved […]...
